stem: Based on the selection from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together,” with which statement would the author most likely agree?
instruction: Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: The movement toward co-living spaces began with generations prior to the Millennials.

options.label: G
options.text: Millennials want numerous opportunities to socialize in their work and everyday lives.

options.label: H
options.text: The most successful companies focus primarily on meeting Millennials’ needs.

options.label: J
options.text: Millennials seek out community but are mostly living and working in isolated situations.
